items.q: Do I need a visa to travel to Thailand for treatment?
items.a: It depends on your nationality and length of stay. Our team will tell you what applies to you and help prepare the documents you need.

items.q: Can I know the treatment cost in advance?
items.a: Yes — we prepare a quote before confirming any appointment, with no hidden costs.

items.q: What currencies can I pay with?
items.a: We accept Thai baht, Lao kip, and international transfers. Ask our team about the most convenient option for you.

items.q: Who takes care of me if there's an emergency during treatment?
items.a: Your personal WOS coordinator is available around the clock and works directly with the hospital until you're safely home.

items.q: Is a Lao-speaking interpreter available during appointments?
items.a: Yes — our team provides an interpreter or coordinator who speaks Lao throughout your appointments.
